column1: # What the guided setup leaves on a machine on purpose, by the item it installs, in the leftover
# audit's own words (tests/leftovers.md, "What the guided setup leaves"): item (as the headless
# setup entry's records name it, `*` and `?` allowed)<TAB>os (linux, macos, windows or any)<TAB>
# kind (kinds.ts)<TAB>glob on the name the report shows (allowlist.tsv's)<TAB>why it stays. The
# entry (integration_tests::setup) puts each `installed:` record's rows in its `leaves`, so a
# caller's allowances come from the records, not from a table of its own; the entry's own temp
# folder is added there with its real path. kinds.test.ts holds the kinds and systems to kinds.ts.
